output.summary: Creeping, mat-forming succulent native to South Africa. Its dull-green or yellow-green leaves may age pink, and its yellow flowers open in bright morning sunlight and close at night. Its fruit and leaves are edible; South African ripe fruit are reportedly eaten fresh or made into tart jam, although that detail is marked as needing a citation.
